name: Infiltrating the Castle
summary: At Stormwind Keep, Elling Trias sends you to meet his fellow operative Tyrion. Tyrion has watched Lord Gregor Lescovar from the royal gardens for weeks.

sections.title: A Matter Outside the Law
sections.body: At his cheese shop in the Trade District, Elling Trias sees the Defias threat reaching into the kingdom's rule. Ordinary law cannot expose or punish a nobleman as protected and entrenched as Lord Gregor Lescovar. So Trias offers a dangerous path: deliver justice within Stormwind Keep, outside the law, and sever the conspiracy for good.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shrubbery
sections.body: Elling Trias has an operative in the high halls: Tyrion, a clever gnome skilled at concealment. For weeks, Tyrion has watched the keep's courtyards and royal gardens. He has tracked Lescovar's movements, who enters his chambers, and when the traitor meets covert Defias contacts. You need to reach Tyrion without drawing the Royal Guard's suspicion.

sections.title: Treason in the Court
sections.body: Lord Lescovar's alliance with the Defias assassin Marzon the Silent Blade shows how deeply Stormwind's court has rotted while King Varian Wrynn is absent. Court nobles scheme within the kingdom as outlaws press its borders from Westfall and the Redridge Mountains. Striking at Lescovar is an attempt to cut out the corruption before the kingdom crumbles.

faq.q: Why does Elling Trias want this handled outside the law?
faq.answer: Lord Lescovar holds great influence and wealth in the House of Nobles. Without indisputable proof, accusations against a high-ranking lord could bring political disaster, see evidence suppressed, and leave whistleblowers executed. Trias believes secret, direct action is the only reliable way to stop the threat.

Tyrion hides in Stormwind Keep's royal gardens, just off the courtyard to the left after you pass through the main gates. From the bushes, he watches Lord Lescovar's quarters without alerting the guards.
Tyrion is a covert operative and trusted associate of Elling Trias. For several weeks, he has watched Stormwind Keep to track Lord Gregor Lescovar and map his secret ties to the Defias.
Lord Gregor Lescovar is a prominent Stormwind nobleman who secretly works with the Defias Brotherhood as an insider in the royal court. He helps them sabotage the kingdom from within.
Marzon, known as the Silent Blade, is an elite Defias assassin. He works directly with Lord Lescovar to coordinate attacks and assassinations for the Brotherhood.

faq.q: Why is Tyrion worried about his reputation?
faq.answer: Tyrion worries you will expose his cover during secret surveillance. He also complains that heavily armed adventurers loitering beside him in the royal shrubbery under the castle guards' noses looks suspicious and unseemly.

angles.text: As a rogue, you help two seasoned underground operatives infiltrate the seat of human nobility. Their work shows the quiet, lethal skill needed to protect Stormwind from threats within its own court.
As a gnome, you see Tyrion carry out long-term covert surveillance inside Stormwind Keep. His work shows how gnomish ingenuity serves espionage as well as machinery.
With King Varian missing, the kingdom cannot afford betrayal in the Keep's highest legislative chamber. As an Alliance member, you help root out conspirators to keep the realm stable.
